root_cause.mechanism: Recurring Monitor reads open URI mode=ro native sqlite3 connections using a with statement. Native sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ commits or rolls back but does not close. URI strings bypass the path-based TrackedConnection matcher, so three recurring connections per idle worker cycle remained open until garbage collection.

repair.mechanism: A Monitor-local _read_only_connection context manager owns explicit close in finally and is used by startup validation plus every recurring and conditional read-only path.

provenance: The live Monitor modules and focused Monitor tests were untracked in the shared workspace at the frozen checkpoint. The repair package therefore records those pre-existing files in full but stages no unrelated untracked dependency or workspace change.
next_action: Do not deploy or restart operation_monitor_worker until separately authorized. A deployment must change only the qualified Monitor modules, restart only operation_monitor_worker, and prove the live wt_ops descriptor count falls and reaches a stable plateau under repeated natural cycles.
